test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, and E are sitting in a straight line facing north. C is exactly in between B and D. E is to the immediate left of B. D is not sitting at the end of the bench. Who is sitting to the immediate right of D?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, and E are sitting in a straight line facing north.

1) C is exactly in between B and D.

2) E is to the immediate left of B.

3) D is not sitting at the end of the bench.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50a0443330f3b3cf799f9f4cf4d4b39f6c6a414896f286a495059e1333b1cfca.png] 

And, A will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b53471c8744dd07f9bfc3ca22ffc2b7161a6bfab4f7e6e09fc1071fe3422e7a.png] 

So, 'A' is sitting to the immediate right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
